title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's

meta.Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhum♪
The lantern can go here and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. Such magnificent decorating skills. Well done, me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, I'm just about done here. How's the doll stand coming along?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Almost there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that looks brilliant! As if it's a model for others to use as an example!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. No, I just looked it up and tried to copy that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But our setup is pretty big compared to normal. Everyone's always surprised when they hear about us having a 7-tiered platform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We were all so happy the day you were born, and dad ended up getting this in the midst of our celebration...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The same goes for your helmet get-up too. He buys this stuff without a second thought, so mom probably has her hands full too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it really feels like the Doll Festival is here when you have a setup that's this big♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I can't wait to celebrate with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Let's make the most of it since we're going to have so many people join us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll also need to come up with introductions!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Introductions...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We have to get started on the right foot, which is why introductions are so important!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should go all out from start to finish! And we'll need a script to let us do that, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa, wait! I just want it to be a normal party! You'll just end up scaring everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And it'll be plenty fun because you'll be there too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fun because I'll be there... And I must fulfill my role as a star!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Tsukasa, can you help me get the emperor and empress ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we're supposed to do them first, but I saved them since I wanted to work on them with you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah! Yes, of course!
It's time to take center stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Let's start with the emperor...! Where is...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, here he is! The emperor♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's in tatters...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
He can go here and...
Next is the empress.
Tsukasa, here♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, it's nothing! Just put this one up there, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This one isn't much better off either...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The dolls that are supposed to be at the very top are in such bad shape...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And done! The Doll Festival decorations are all finished!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It really is something to behold when it's all set up! Nicely done, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
It's been a while so I kinda just let myself go! And thanks for helping me, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait for the party either. I really want everyone to see this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm glad Saki is enjoying herself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's also stayed healthy and has been able to go to school like normal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I hope she'll have fun and be able to fondly look back upon this event.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But the condition those dolls are in...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is the first time in a while where we're celebrating the Doll Festival at home, so Saki needs to enjoy it as much as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (For that to happen...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just you wait, Saki!
You'll remember this as the greatest Doll Festival ever!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahoy, KAITO! I came to play!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're not here to play. We're here to prac... Emu, wait! Don't run off like that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Welcome to SEKAI. You all seem like you're full of energy today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. We'd like to try something out for a show, if you don't mind that is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! I'm curious to see what you're gonna do!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is so exciting☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just gonna be something way too crazy again, though...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get started!
KAITO, may we use the stage...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, before you do, I'd like to introduce a new troupe member.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! Someone new?!
What are they like?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm... Well, they're super laid-back♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Laid-back...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
MEIKO just went to get them so...
Oh, there they are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We're here, everyone!
Thanks for waiting!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huff... MEIKO... You didn't have to sprint like that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha...?! Megurine Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? You must be the ones...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-She fell asleep...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sleeping while standing is a very unique skill. I believe zebras do that as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh! Luka, wake up! Everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Hm?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, don't talk in your sleep!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha. Well, that's Luka for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. This SEKAI just keeps getting livelier and livelier.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! Since Luka's here now, we should all do something fun together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, good idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Me too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm all for that!
But what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something really spectacular, I say!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Something super spectacular...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, how about a really big party☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A party...? Then how about a Doll Festival party?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My sister is having one with her friends as well, and it's bound to be a blast!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A Doll Festival party?!
That sounds like fun♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But what do you do during the Doll Festival?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... It's a festival for girls that you celebrate on March 3rd every year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We all get out our special dolls, eat chirashi sushi, drink amazake and party together☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A festival for girls, huh? That makes Luka the perfect candidate to be our lead!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yawn... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then a party on March 3rd it is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, but I won't be able to make it. Just as I mentioned, my sister is having her party then as well, so I'll be with her then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! If you can't come, Tsukasa, then we can have it on another day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, but a Doll Festival party should be held on the day of, so don't mind me. Try to have fun with everyone else, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But... Okay, I guess it is a special day for Saki too so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There isn't much we can do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, however... I could make you a device that lets you hear Tsukasa's voice each time you press its button, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Yay! Then it'll be like Tsukasa's here too☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you're just replacing him with a soundboard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Since it's the Doll Festival, it'd be nice to have lots of dolls here too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Dolls, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember breaking a few of them and having Rui fix them for me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that did happen.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can fix those dolls too? I suppose I should expect no less from you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I just had him patch them up before my parents found out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they caught me after they started flashing lights, flying and singing in the middle of the night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did get a little carried away that time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's amazing! I wish my dolls could fly too, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, I don't think those dolls are really meant to do that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you have these dolls at your house too, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! For me and my big sister!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why we have two sets♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! You really do all have them! We wanna have a party with those dolls too☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too! We can even put them on display using the stage!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Our dolls are gonna shine in the spotlight♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, we can have it fully illuminated! A disco ball may do nicely too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This might get out of control if we leave them to their own devices...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It sure might...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And it sounds super fun! Let's help them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I do have Saki's party to attend to...
But I can at least help set things up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Luka! Let's make it a really amazing party♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If we can have some of those cute dolls here, I'm sure it'll turn into a great party.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you'll need a set of dolls so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then as part of welcoming Luka into our troupe, let's start planning our Doll Festival party!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So Luka, what kind of party...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! She fell asleep again?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she's sleeping like a baby☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Needing those dolls...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Right! I'll just have to go forward with that plan then...!!)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Bookstore Clerk
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I got a hold of the new volume I wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I'll do some solo practice too since Akito has work today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hm? Is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
No, that won't work either...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, next is that store!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, Toya!
Fancy meeting you here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was out buying something from the bookstore. Are you shopping too, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, thank you for asking!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My little sister, Saki, is having a Doll Festival party with her friends!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A Doll Festival party?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! With Saki in the hospital, we weren't able to celebrate as usual... But this year is different!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's her first Doll Festival since she became healthy! That's why I need to make sure she has the best party possible too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I must fulfill this duty as her big brother, which is why I've come here to buy what we need!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All for Saki... Hehe. I wouldn't expect any less from you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you like some help carrying anything?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure you'll have quite a bit to carry back if it's going to be such a great party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True. Your help will be much appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's get going. Our first stop is...
Department Store

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, this is the place I was looking for!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is... A special Doll Festival section?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed!
Now to find the perfect dolls!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, is this what you're here to buy? I was under the impression you were buying party supplies...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some of our dolls are in pretty bad shape, so I thought it'd be nice to replace them with new ones...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In bad shape...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it's all my fault...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How so?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It happened while Saki was still at a hospital in the city...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow! This cake is so cute! The emperor and empress are on top of it too♪

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: You got some cream on your cheek, Saki. Here, let me get it for you.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: But you're really okay with just cake?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: If you want a set of dolls for your room, I can go buy some right now!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: No, it's fine! We already have a huge set at home so...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's laughing on the outside, but probably feels so lonely on the inside...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then that means I should...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm the Doll Ranger, the Black Emperor!!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll deal with the one that's making you feel so sad, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: But really, it's okay! I'm used to sleeping by myself now, so I don't feel lonely at all♪

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late... Saki, we need to head back soon so...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Call me if you ever start feeling lonely again! I'll be by your side in no time!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
I will, Tsukasa!
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: I'm glad she'll be able to come home soon...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Me too. She's really come a long way. She even ate her cake without leaving as much as a crumb behind.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I left my handkerchief in her room!
I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish I could see our dolls...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She really did want to see them...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then I'll...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnng! There...! I managed to get the emperor and empress down...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That should do it! Now, all I need to do is sneak them out before mom and dad notice...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Almost at the hospital...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hang on, Saki!
I'll be right... Wah!!
se_event_hinamatsuri_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oww...! Th-That was pretty bad...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
The dolls...!!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, what do I do? They got all dirty...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't show them to her like this...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: No...! I'm her big brother!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to make her smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Saki!!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Tsukasa?
Did you forget something else?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, it's not that!
I came here to bring you these!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Th-Those are our dolls...!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: But why...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I really wanted you to see them...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't bring them all, so I thought I could bring at least the ones at the very top to show you!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... I'm so sorry... I fell on the way here and got them all dirty...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: They mean so much to you but I...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: No, it's okay! I'm really happy that you did this...!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki smiled...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They're all dirty...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It did. I still remember that look on her face and couldn't bear to see her like that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I went to look for a good replacement after that, but I couldn't actually buy one on just my allowance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I devised this plan! My goal of one day buying Saki the perfect dolls!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa... All this for Saki...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I wouldn't expect any less. If you'll have me, I'd like to help you with your plan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Toya. Feel free to tell me what you think as well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's start with... How about this one?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is... Kimono, hair, eyes, everything in gold! The Golden Doll?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, but would it not be perfect to sit on top of the stand? Just as a star shines on top of the stage, I'm sure Saki will enjoy seeing this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It also looks very expensive, and Saki may feel a bit awkward about you buying something like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... That would also be bad...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then... How about this one?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The Doll with a Disco Ball...?! You really seem to be drawn towards the shiny ones, Tsukasa. How about something more, you know, traditional?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Th-This is tougher than I expected...!
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for your help today, Toya. Especially considering I've been keeping you from reading the book you bought earlier...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, please don't mind that. I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, over there... Is that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa! And Toya!
Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, if it isn't Saki and the gang.
Here for a visit?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, Tsukasa.
Oh, and this is...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, meet Toya. He's my junior and was helping me out with some shopping today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, this is Ichika, Honami and Shiho.
They're Saki's childhood friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Pleased to meet you all.
My name is Toya.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, yes. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He seems much more down-to-earth compared to Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho, let's keep that to ourselves...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it looks like you got a lot of stuff, Tsukasa! What exactly were you out buying?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, they're all Doll Festival party goods!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, all of it?! Whoa!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa takes such good care of Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That I can't deny.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This party should be a lot of fun. Right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thank you for helping Tsukasa today, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were indeed a big help! Again, thank you! And see you at school!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it was nothing. It was fun to help out. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tsukasa thought long and hard about which dolls to buy. Saki also seemed very happy with all of her friends around...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope their party turns out well.)
Doll Festival Day - Early morning
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. Saki still seems to be asleep. Now, to put the new dolls I bought on display!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's take the old ones and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The closer I look, the worse they seem...
Their hair's completely out of place...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And this is it for these dolls...
Maybe I shouldn't just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait! No, I can't start getting all sentimental now. I'll swap them out for now and deal with them later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just have to put them up here...
And done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I can't wait to see the look on Saki's face!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, what to do with the old ones? They're in tatters, so I could just toss them out but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've always wondered why dad just kept these as they were... They've been kept as clean as they can be but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Tsukasa, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wah!! S-Saki?!
You're up already?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I woke up and couldn't fall back asleep!
I could ask you the same thing, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait... Are those my dolls in your hand?

rows.Line: He's been saving up for years in order to see you smile and be happy.

rows.Line: What? Tsukasa never mentioned anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What he got may've ended up being not to your liking but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just wanted you to understand why he did what he did and how much thought he put into it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Let's make the most of it since we're going to have so many people join us!

rows.Line: But I just...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: She did! She even came all the way over to my school to tell me!

rows.Line: And I'm sorry for not replying to your text! I forgot to take my phone with me and didn't know that you'd sent me anything!

rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Ouch...!

rows.Line: But I'm sorry! What I did made you worry and feel uneasy...

rows.Line: And I tried to swap out your precious dolls without actually considering how you'd feel about it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just ended up hurting you instead...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:

rows.Line: But I always just end up making you feel worse...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm a disgrace as a big brother...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! Don't say that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's true that I did feel sad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really did think you forgot about that day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that's no excuse for saying the things I did... I'm so sorry...

rows.Line: But can you at least tell me this? What am I forgetting about that day exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I ran over to the hospital to bring you those dolls, fell and got them dirty...

rows.Line: And you looked so sad as you held them in your hands. That's all I honestly remember.

rows.Line: You made yourself smile to keep me from worrying any more...

rows.Line: Huh? Wait, I made myself smile...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

It all makes sense now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

I wasn't making myself smile or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so happy that you came, I almost started to cry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I thought you'd feel terrible if I started crying and you wanted me to be happy so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I might've ended up making a weird smile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, so you really were happy that time...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I was so unbelievably happy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so happy that you brought me my dolls even after getting covered in scrapes and bruises.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No matter how dirty these dolls get, they'll always mean everything to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I thought when you bought me those new dolls that you'd completely forgotten about what happened with the old ones. That's why I felt so sad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

You still remembered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Line: Of course I did! How can I forget something like that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I misunderstood you as well, Saki. I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you don't have to apologize.
I should be the one to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always kept how I actually felt a secret to make sure you wouldn't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't just say what I really meant. I just smiled and nodded. It's no wonder that you didn't understand how I really felt, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I made you go through all of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thank you so much. You bringing me my dolls was one of the happiest moments of my life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, my one and only big brother...
I'm proud to be your little sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: SAKIIII!!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Tsukasa, too loud! You're gonna make our neighbors wonder what's going on...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!! My precious little sister! The best little sister anyone could ask for!!
